Gujarat Primary Schools Announce 21-Day Diwali Vacation Starting November 5

29 Oct 2026, 06:35 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Education Desk · Source: timesofindia.indiatimes.com

Primary schools across Gujarat are scheduled to observe a 21-day Diwali vacation beginning November 5 and extending through November 25, under a recent directive from the Directorate of Primary Education.

According to the official circular, educational institutions will reopen on November 26, which marks the commencement of the second academic term.

Administrative Coordination and Scope

The circular has been formally distributed to district education officers (DEOs), district primary education officers (DPEOs), and administrative officers throughout the state. Authorities have been instructed to coordinate vacation timelines carefully to ensure uniformity between primary and secondary schools in their respective jurisdictions.

Additionally, officials are tasked with informing all government and grant-in-aid teacher training institutes, pre-primary teacher training institutes, and self-financed PTC colleges about the approved schedule.

Special Provision for Teacher Training Institutes

Under the announced arrangements, first-year students enrolled in teacher training institutes are scheduled to begin their academic activities on November 19. This specific adjustment is designed to enable students to complete the required number of working days mandated by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) norms.

Practical Implications and Verification

For families and school administrators, the confirmed dates provide a clear framework for planning the upcoming festive season and the transition into the second academic term. Readers seeking to verify the original circular and specific administrative instructions can consult the official report published by The Times of India at https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/ahmedabad/21-day-diwali-break-for-primary-schools-from-nov-5/articleshow/135244480.cms.
